title: Wyman Ham's origins
summary: The interviewer asks where Wyman Ham was from; Manetta only knew him from the audience and says he may have had no home and used drugs.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: I wonder where he was from? Was he from Birmingham or something? Or did he just have that foundation?

Well in fact, I couldn't exactly tell you, Wyman Ham's home, but I knew him from the audience. He might not have had a home. Because he was one of dopey, he used to use hop and things. He meant black people. Black people.
